description: Employment offer letter, employment contract, or employment agreement

clauses.name: Compensation and Salary
clauses.description: Base salary, pay frequency, currency, payment method

low: Clear fixed compensation with defined pay schedule

clauses.name: Benefits and Perks
clauses.description: Health insurance, retirement, PTO, equity, bonuses

high: Benefits described as discretionary with no minimum guarantees
medium: Benefits 'subject to change' with no notice requirement
low: Clear benefits package with specific entitlements

clauses.name: Employment Term
clauses.description: Fixed term vs. at-will, start date, probationary period

high: At-will with no notice requirement for termination
medium: Long probationary period with reduced rights
low: Fixed term with clear conditions for renewal or non-renewal

clauses.name: Termination and Notice Period
clauses.description: How employment can be ended, required notice, severance

high: Employer can terminate without cause and without notice or severance
low: Balanced termination rights with reasonable notice and severance

clauses.name: Non-Compete Clause
clauses.description: Restrictions on working for competitors after employment

high: Broad geographic scope and long duration (>2 years)
low: Narrow and reasonable scope, or no non-compete

clauses.name: Non-Solicitation Clause
clauses.description: Restrictions on soliciting company clients or employees

high: Broadly defined to cover any business contact
low: Narrowly scoped to direct clients for reasonable period

clauses.name: Intellectual Property Assignment
clauses.description: Ownership of work created during employment

high: Assigns ALL inventions including personal/prior work
medium: Broad assignment but limited to work-related creations
low: Clear assignment of work product only, with pre-existing IP carve-out

high: Definition of confidential info is extremely broad
medium: Broad definition but with standard exclusions
low: Reasonable scope with clear exclusions and limited duration

clauses.name: Probation Period
clauses.description: Initial probation period terms and conditions

high: Extended probation (>6 months) with significantly reduced benefits or rights
medium: Standard probation with reduced notice period
low: Reasonable probation period (1-3 months) with clear expectations

high: Mandatory arbitration waiving right to class action
medium: Mandatory arbitration but with employer paying costs
low: Mediation first, with retained right to pursue legal remedies

high: Governing law differs from employee's work location
